next.reason: 1985: 'RECORD CONTAINS integer-1 CHARACTERS'; 2023: 'RECORD CONTAINS integer-1 ╭ BYTES ╮ ┤ ├ ╰ CHARACTERS ╯ (BYTES alternative also in formats 2 and 3)'. The same three formats remain, but 2023 adds BYTES as an alternative to CHARACTERS, so it accepts e.g. RECORD CONTAINS 80 BYTES, which the 1985 syntax refuses.
